A security update: the archives, packages and container image of Lucid are now built with Go 1.26.11, which fixes a crash of the HTTP server in Go's standard library when a request body exceeds its size limit ([GO-2026-6859](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859)). The crash needs a handler that reads the request body while it writes the response at the same time; Lucid reads a request body before it answers, so no way to trigger it in Lucid is known. This release ships the fixed code, so you do not have to rely on that.

Lucid itself and its settings are unchanged.

## Known issues

The Nix package is still built with Go 1.26.10, because NixOS 26.05 does not have Go 1.26.11 yet. A later release brings it to Nix once it does; until then, 0.1.2 is the same as 0.1.1 with Nix.

## Upgrading

A deb, rpm or Arch package of 0.1.2 installs over 0.1.1 and restarts a running service. The container image is `0.1.2` or `latest`. With Nix, `nix flake update` brings 0.1.2 if you follow `github:tbckr/lucid/stable`, but it changes nothing for you yet (see above).
